notes: Item 19 discloses 2025 performance data for franchisees open at least 12 months. Revenue data covers 110 franchisees across 4 tiers (28/28/28/29 outlets). Expense/EBITDA data covers 61 active franchisees (79 P&L reports received but 61 in good standing) operating 75 locations. The tier definitions (revenue thresholds) are not explicitly stated in the extracted text. The expense table's Min/Max columns represent the entire expense profile of the location with the lowest and highest Adjusted EBITDA respectively — not statistical min/max of each individual line item — which limits comparability. A Revenue by Category table (Death-Related Bio, Hoarding, etc.) was present in the images on page 38 but contained aggregate system revenue figures ($22.5M, $10.6M, etc.) rather than per-franchisee metrics, so those were not extracted as individual cohort records. The cohort_name 'open_12_24mo' was used as a proxy for 'open at least 12 months' since that was the minimum threshold; the actual cohort spans multiple tenure durations.
